newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW raises BAe estimates.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BZW raises BAe estimates.

text.p: Earnings estimates for British Aerospace Plc through the next five years have been raised by BZW, market sources said on Wednesday.

The brokerage raised its pre-tax profit forecast for 1996 by five percent to 425 million stg. It raised its estimates progressively for the following four years, giving an estimate for 2000 up 17 percent to 870 million stg.
BZW also put a value of over 16.00 stg on BAe shares, based on the price Boeing paid for McDonnell Douglas, sources said. It has a "buy" rating on the stock.
Analysts at the brokerage were not immediately available for comment. The stock was up 1p at 11.56-1/2 stg by 1523 GMT.
